changelog: Forge loops v0.5.9: new BASE DEFENSE mode — build phase, then defend a 1000-HP voxel core against waves (Forge structures absorb damage first; player death redeploys, the run ends when the core falls). Installed JSON weapon-mods are now first-class weapons in Arsenal/Loadouts (mod:<id>). Edit installed mods in the Mods tab with a diff approval (e.g. Version 1.0 -> 1.1) before installing the update. New take_damage hook: shield / vulnerable / thorns / petrified, resolved before damage applies. MAKE parity: MAKE builds now go through ForgeManager (history, shared undo, MP-sync, PLACED STRUCTURES listing) and script-shaped MAKE works in-session via session code loading — no file I/O, peers never auto-run another peer's code.
